Use case: logo-brand. A rigorous professional identity exploration board for Plated, a household recipe and dinner planning iOS app. Landscape board, warm off-white #FAF9F4 background, dark green #191C17 typography. Heading "Plated" with small caption "Identity study / 02". Two columns only, large icons plus tiny matching icon repeats. No marketing slogans. LEFT label "A / The serving plate": deep green rounded square iOS icon with a cream #EDF0E6 custom bold symbol: an elegantly drawn circular plate rim with a deliberate broad break in the upper-right quadrant and an offset short curved segment echoing a serving gesture. The mark must read as a welcoming ceramic plate, not power button, letter C, loading spinner or camera lens. One heavy outer rim, one restrained inner curved rim, a deliberate asymmetry; excellent small-scale legibility. RIGHT label "B / The Plated initial": deep green rounded square with a cream bespoke uppercase P monogram. Sculptural editorial serif construction, sturdy vertical stem with gently flared foot, generously rounded bowl evoking a plate, a distinctive small open cut at the bowl/stem junction, custom drawn not a stock font glyph. Quiet confident and warm rather than fashion luxury. Under each large icon show the SAME mark at small sizes on green square, and a standalone monochrome dark green silhouette on cream. All flat vector-like precision, no gradients, textures, fake lighting, drop shadows, ornamental utensil clipart, arrows, extra shapes, or explanatory body copy. Wide generous margins, highly crafted geometry. These are two competing concept sketches, not approved final logos.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined high-fidelity four-screen iPhone design presentation for Plated, a household recipe and dinner planning app. Landscape board with four front-on phone screens fully visible side by side on warm cream background. Heading "Plated / Dinner starts here". Small captions above screens: "01 Welcome", "02 Your first recipe", "03 Save a recipe", "04 Ready to use". Editorial app design: solid deep green #191C17 backgrounds, cream #EDF0E6 Newsreader-style readable serif headings, DM Sans-style body, sage #B0B8A8 secondary labels, thin green-gray #3A4434 rules, orange #FF5A3C committing action buttons with very dark text and 6px corner radii. No gradients, glows, decorative card piles or big celebration screens. Realistic iPhone proportions, readable polished UI.
SCREEN 1 welcome: small Plated serif wordmark aligned left at top. Modest rectangular editorial photo of a believable weeknight dinner: two mismatched ceramic bowls of pasta, slightly rumpled kitchen tea towel, water glass, cropped hand serving from pan, warm daylight in an ordinary home, no flowers, no extravagant table styling. Below photo large serif headline "Good food.\nA little more together." Body "Your recipes, dinner plans, and shopping list. Together." Main orange full-width "Add your first recipe". Secondary plain text "Plan a night" underneath. Fine horizontal rule, text link "Have a household invitation?" with chevron. SCREEN 3 add recipe: native-style sheet on deep green, top left "Cancel", centered "Add a recipe". Large serif "A good recipe\nstarts anywhere." Label "Recipe link". SCREEN 4 actual saved recipe detail: top back chevron and small "Recipes", trailing ellipsis. Large near-square-corner photo of lemon pasta in ordinary ceramic bowl, then serif "Lemon pasta", small metadata "25 min · Serves 2". A quiet inline checkmark and "Saved to Recipes".
